defs.def: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting （会议的）议程表，议事日程

ex.s: So an was launched and a “clean-up” campaign was added to the government agenda, including large vehicles from passing through the village.
ex.t: 于是发起了一项____，并把“清理”活动列入政府议程，包括____大型车辆穿过村庄。

ex.s: That reminds me of … The next item on the agenda is … I think we ought to move on to … On the one hand … On the other hand … Oh, there was something I meant to tell you.
ex.t: 这让我想起了……议程上的下一个议题是……我认为我们应该继续推进……一方面……另一方面……哦，有件事我本想告诉你。

ex.s: Heritage protection is at the top of the agenda for the benefit of all mankind.
ex.t: 保护文化遗产是造福全人类的首要议题。
